title: Ophiopogon Wooden Anvil
description: Ophiopogon Wooden Anvil offers wooden anvils made from various types of wood
body:
Adds wooden anvils made from various types of wood to Minecraft.

- 72 types of wooden anvils: 12 types of wood × with/without skin × three states: intact/cracked/damaged

- Complete anvil GUI: Functions identically to vanilla anvils, allowing repair and enchanting on wooden anvils.

- Damage Degradation: Like vanilla anvils, there's a chance of damage during use (intact → cracked → damaged → destroyed).

- Axe Peeling: Crouch + right-click the axe to convert a withered wooden anvil into the corresponding peeled variant.

- Texture Pack Compatibility: Wood textures reference vanilla resources and support changes with texture packs; cracked/damaged overlays are mod-provided textures.

Supports all vanilla wood (MC 26.1.2), each type of wood has three states: intact, cracked, and damaged, for a total of 72 wooden anvils.
